People: Julian Ralph (author, Wikidata Q28777086), died 1903; Frederic Remington (illustrator, Wikidata Q560787), died 1909. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Ralph, Julian, 1853-1903; Remington, Frederic, 1861-1909 [Illustrator]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: On Canada's frontier [microform] : sketches of history, sport, and adventure and of the Indians, missionaries, fur-traders, and newer settlers of western Canada, London : J.R. Osgood, 1892, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/cihm_15974. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 100%, 90%, 85% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Frederic Remington, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
